_comment: docs/13 rule (2026-10-06): from the next release on, every published package has ONE build number on all six subdirs. `release` = the number every subdir must carry (null = pre-rule generation, judged against `legacy`). `hotfixes` = declared per-subdir rebuilds between releases (also listed in docs/14). `legacy` = the per-subdir spread of the pre-rule 23.1.1 generation; delete it with the first aligned release.
